evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software engineering artifacts written in domain-specific languages (DSLs).

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Under a sound backend verifier, MeMoDecode never performs worse than grammar-constrained decoding on alignment metrics satisfying natural assumptions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across four DSLs and six open-weight LLMs ranging from 0.6B to 70B parameters, MeMoDecode achieves the highest consistency, improving consistency by 23% on average over unconstrained decoding and by 8% on average over grammar-constrained decoding.
